CustomField.description: Minutes to wait before each automatic retry, from 0 to 10. Useful when a job fails because an external system is down or rate-limiting: retrying at once usually fails again. Blank or 0 retries right away.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Minutes to wait before each retry, 0 to 10. Blank or 0 retries right away.
CustomField.label: Retry Delay Minutes
